A monthly-payment function uses only principal, interest rate, and loan duration. Which is the best reason to treat its output as a model rather than a complete description of a real mortgage payment?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_d06.model.05
- 'The function has inputs and therefore cannot be mathematical.':
    correct: false
- 'Real mortgages may also involve fees, insurance, or other dimensions not included in the function.':
    correct: true
- 'A model can never produce a numerical output.':
    correct: false
- 'The output must always be unrelated to the inputs.':
    correct: false
```
